params.body:
Context for the handover (#77) could be added to a project, person, machine or material in Verkennen, and to a relation in Netwerk. Two gaps:
- the project dots in the Netwerk graph opened nothing, so a project seen there had no place for its context;
- nowhere could you see which nodes already carry context, so the overview of what was told lived only on Overdracht.

## A project in Netwerk opens its own panel

- **The panel.** Picking a project, as a dot in the graph or as a row in the list under it, opens a panel in the side column:
  - its label and last date;
  - who was on it, each a click away from its own panel;
  - "Openen in Verkennen" when the project is a site there;
  - its context for the handover.
- **Same anchor as Verkennen.** The context panel uses `project:<Bouwsoft key>`, the same anchor Verkennen uses for that site, so a note written in either place shows in both.
- **Switching.** Picking a relation closes the project panel.
- **In the URL.** The project is kept in the URL as `project=`.

## Marked wherever it shows

| Where | Mark |
|---|---|
| Netwerk graph | a small amber dot on the top right of a dot (2D); the tooltip counts the notes (also in 3D) |
| Netwerk list under the graph | "context N" on the row |
| Netwerk, Contacten tab | "context N" after the name |
| Verkennen tables (projects, people, machines, material) | "context N" after the name |

- **Live updates.** The graph asks which dots carry context (`noted()`, renderless) when it starts, and again when a note is saved or deleted (`NodeContext` dispatches `context-saved`). A new note marks its dot and row without the picture starting over.
- **One component.** `x-context-mark` is the mark wherever a Blade table shows one.

## Tests

- `ContextEverywhereTest` covers:
  - a project picked in Netwerk shows its relations, its context and a link to Verkennen, and picking a relation closes it;
  - `noted()` maps relation and project anchors to graph ids and leaves the rest out;
  - Contacten shows the mark;
  - a saved note dispatches `context-saved`;
  - Verkennen's `noted` maps a project's anchor to its site id.
- Full suite green, JS 15/15.
- Walked through in headless Chromium on a copy of the production-size database:
  - one marked row at the start;
  - open a relation's projects and pick one: its panel shows who was on it;
  - add context: the row is marked at once (2 marked), with no page errors.

params.title: Context on every node: a project panel in Netwerk, and a mark wherever a node carries context
